Order No.02 Dated-09-06-2025 Heard the parties.
The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Radhanagar P.S. Case No.104 of 2024 registered for the offence punishable under Section 341, 323, 376, 504, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner has committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
It is next submitted that the allegation against the petitioner is false.

Drawing attention of this Court towards page-16 of the brief which is the copy of the certified copy of the petition filed by the informant in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Rajmahal, it is jointly submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner as as the learned counsel for the informant that therein the alleged victim has categorically stated that she does not want to proceed with the case.
It is then submitted that the petitioner has been in custody since 24.02.2025 as is evident from para-1 of the instant bail application.
It is also submitted that charge-sheet has already been submitted.
It is further submitted that the petitioner has no criminal antecedent as mentioned in para-12 of the instant bail application.

It is also submitted that this case Arban Ghosh vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 9 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31833997/
1

entities.text: Arban Ghosh vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: has been instituted falsely to pressurize the petitioner to marry the victim.
It is lastly submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the trial of the case.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner be released on bail.
Learned Addl.P.P. appearing for the State and the learned counsel for the informant oppose the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

Considering the facts of this case, the above-named petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Rajmahal in connection with Radhanagar P.S. Case No.104 of 2024 with the condition that he will co-operate with the trial of the case and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card in the court below with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the trial of the case.

(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Saroj/
